query: SELECT a.user_id,a.credential_ciphertext FROM imap_accounts a JOIN email_links l ON l.id=a.link_id WHERE a.link_id=$1 AND a.sync_generation=$2 AND a.grant_generation=$3 AND l.macro_id=a.user_id AND l.provider='IMAP' AND l.is_sync_active AND NOT l.needs_reauth AND l.sync_generation=a.sync_generation AND l.grant_generation=a.grant_generation
